name: manual_122620
claim: Qualify field semantics by operation and version: an advisory route hint must not restrict routing, while an authoritative fanout target list belongs to structural identity.

decisions.notes: The earlier exporter wrongly restricted dynamic routes using declared_targets. In R3 fanout the same field actually selects executed branches, so its candidate registry category is structural. A field name alone does not determine its contract.
